name: Dish antenna symbol
summary: Symbol for a parabolic dish antenna used for satellite reception or microwave links.
description: A dish antenna is drawn as a curved reflector with a feed point and a support line. It is used on TV distribution drawings for satellite reception and on communication drawings for point-to-point microwave links.

Dish positions need line of sight to the satellite arc or the far end, and wind loading on the mount. The plan symbol therefore sits on site or roof plans with orientation notes. The symbol does not show the dish size or pointing angles, which come from the link design.
drawingChecklist: Show feeder and LNB or radio unit.
distinction: The general antenna symbol has no reflector; the dish symbol shows the parabolic reflector.
